description: This Java source file defines the ActionBarMechanics activity, demonstrating how to implement and manage an Action Bar within an Android application. It covers setting up the Action Bar, populating the options menu, and handling menu item selections.

classes.name: ActionBarMechanics
classes.description: An Activity demonstrating the use of the Action Bar, including menu creation and handling.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, requests the feature for the Action Bar before setting content view.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Populates the options menu with items, setting 'show as action' attributes where appropriate.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles selection of menu items; in this case, displays a toast with the selected item name.
